verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own 3D Secure solution. It supports configurable rules that force a challenge above an amount threshold, and webhook notifications so the issuer can deliver the challenge through its own channel, such as an app push. That covers part of the online-credential side of the story. There is no evidence of API-driven PIN set or reset flows, and no explicit 3DS enrollment endpoint, so only roughly half the story is shown. missing for 10: PIN set/reset API endpoints, explicit programmatic 3DS enrollment per card/region, evidence that credential changes avoid support tickets, independent corroboration.
